chatParticipants.name: lace
chatParticipants.description: Compose Terraform infrastructure using natural language

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a module to the canvas

languageModelTools.name: lace_search_registry
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the Lace module registry for Terraform modules by keyword, cloud system (aws/azure/gcp), or category. Returns module names, versions, and descriptions. Always use this before adding a module.

languageModelTools.name: lace_describe_graph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the current canvas state. Note: a canvas snapshot is already provided at the start of each message — only call this if you need updated state after making changes, or need error details not in the snapshot.

languageModelTools.name: lace_add_module
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a Terraform module to the Lace canvas. Requires the exact module name from a registry search. The module will be placed on the canvas as a new instance.

system.description: Cloud system: 'aws', 'azure', or 'gcp'. Helps disambiguate if name exists across systems.

languageModelTools.name: lace_remove_module
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove a module instance from the Lace canvas by its instance ID. Use lace_describe_graph first to find the correct instance_id.

languageModelTools.name: lace_connect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wire a specific output from one module instance to an input on another. Use lace_describe_graph first to see available outputs and inputs.

source_instance.description: Instance ID of the source module (has the output)

target_instance.description: Instance ID of the target module (has the input)

source_output.description: Name of the output on the source instance

target_input.description: Name of the input on the target instance

languageModelTools.name: lace_disconnect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove a wire from a specific input on a module instance. This clears the binding on that input.

target_instance.description: Instance ID of the module with the input to disconnect

input_name.description: Name of the input to disconnect

languageModelTools.name: lace_set_input
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set the value of an input on a module instance. Provide exactly one of: value (literal), variable (var reference), or expression (HCL). Use lace_describe_graph to see available inputs.

input_name.description: Name of the input to set

value.description: Literal value (string, number, boolean, object, or array)

languageModelTools.name: lace_rename_instance
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a module instance on the canvas. The new name must be a valid Terraform identifier. All references (bindings, exports, depends_on) are updated automatically.

new_id.description: New instance ID (must be a valid Terraform identifier)

languageModelTools.name: lace_inspect_module
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the input/output schema of a module in the REGISTRY — before it is added to the canvas. The name must follow 'system/name' format (e.g., 'aws/vpc'). Do NOT use this for instances already on the canvas — use lace_inspect_node for that instead.

version.description: Specific version (optional, uses latest if omitted)

languageModelTools.name: lace_validate_graph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run graph validation on the current canvas state. Checks for dangling references, missing modules, duplicate IDs, and invalid bindings. Use after making changes to verify correctness.

languageModelTools.name: lace_workspace_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the user's project files (package.json, Dockerfile, go.mod, README, main.tf, etc.) to understand what they are building. Use this to suggest appropriate infrastructure modules.

languageModelTools.name: lace_auto_connect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Automatically wire compatible outputs from a source instance to unbound required inputs on a target instance using name and type matching. Use when you want best-effort wiring between two instances without specifying each connection.

source_instance.description: Instance ID of the source module (provides outputs)

target_instance.description: Instance ID of the target module (needs inputs)

languageModelTools.name: lace_generate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate Terraform .tf files from the current canvas state. The canvas validates the graph first, then generates files into the .lace/ directory. This is a fire-and-forget action.

languageModelTools.name: lace_inspect_node
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the live input bindings and outputs of a module instance that is already placed on the canvas. Use this (NOT lace_inspect_module) when you need to see what values are currently set on a canvas instance like 'vpc' or 'subnet_1'. Shows each input's current binding mode (empty/literal/variable/expression/wired), current value, and all outputs.

instance_id.description: The canvas instance ID (e.g., 'vpc', 'subnet_1') — NOT a registry module name

languageModelTools.name: lace_get_settings
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current canvas-level settings: terraform block (required_version, required_providers, backend), configured providers, and locals. Use this to understand what Terraform infrastructure settings are already configured.

languageModelTools.name: lace_set_variable
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add or update a canvas-level Terraform input variable (var.NAME). Use this to create configurable parameters that can be referenced by module inputs using lace_set_input with the variable binding type.

name.description: Variable name — must be a valid Terraform identifier (e.g., 'vpc_cidr', 'environment')

required.description: Whether the variable is required (no default) or optional

description.description: Human-readable description of what this variable controls

default.description: Default value for the variable (any type matching the declared type)

languageModelTools.name: lace_undo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Undo the last change made to the canvas. Use this immediately after making a wrong connection, adding a wrong module, or setting an incorrect value. Returns the updated canvas state after undo.

lace.binaryPath.description: Path to the lace CLI binary

lace.autoSave.description: Automatically save canvas changes. When disabled, use Cmd+S to save manually.
